****[[2026 Iran war ceasefire|Islamabad Accord]]
*****[[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces on his [[Truth Social]] that, based on conversations with [[Pakistan]]i [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|prime minister]] [[Shehbaz Sharif]] and [[Field marshal (Pakistan)|field marshal]] [[Asim Munir]], he has agreed to "suspend the bombing and attacks on Iran for a period of two weeks", subject to Iran agreeing to the "complete, immediate and safe opening" of the [[Strait of Hormuz]], and to allow time for an agreement to be reached. [https://www.wionews.com/photos/iran-envoy-to-pakistan-gives-update-on-negotiations-ahead-of-trump-s-tuesday-deadline-critical-stage-of-talks-war-to-end-big-power-plant-strike-1775546363320/1775546363321#goog_rewarded (WION)] [https://arynews.tv/pakistan-efforts-to-stop-war-critical-stage-iran-ambassador.amp (ARY News)]
*****Trump tells [[Fox News]] that the U.S. is in "heated negotiations" with Iran after being briefed about the proposal. [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-deadline-power-plants-human-chains-israel-train-strikes/#post-update-1ce8735f (CBS News)]
*****It is reported that [[Vice President of the United States|U.S. vice president]] [[JD Vance]] would serve as the U.S. [[interlocutor (politics)|interlocutor]] in [[ceasefire]] talks. [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-deadline-power-plants-human-chains-israel-train-strikes/#post-update-62ba923d (CBS News)]
****Trump warns that "a whole [[Iranian civilization|civilization]] will [[genocide|die tonight]]" and will "never be brought back" if [[Iran]] does not agree to a deal by noon ([[Greenwich Mean Time|GMT]]). [https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-israel-trump-lebanon-april-7-2026-421ee64fdc9a5c26460df8119c7d1b3f (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/trump-says-a-whole-civilization-will-die-tonight-if-iran-does-not-make-deal-2026-04-07/ (Reuters)]
****''[[The New York Times]]'' reports that Iran has ended direct contact with the U.S. in response to Trump's latest threat to "end its civilization". However, ''[[Tehran Times]]'' denies the reports by stating on [[X (social network)|X]] that "diplomatic and indirect channels of talks with [the] U.S. are not closed". [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/iran-cuts-direct-diplomacy-with-us-amid-rising-tensions-ahead-of-trumps-deadline/3896455 (AA)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/live-blog/2026-04-07/iran-latest-trump-hormuz-threats-deadline-middle-east-conflict-oil-markets (Bloomberg)] [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202604077730?source=share-link (Iran International)]
****Vance says that the war in Iran will conclude "very shortly", claiming that the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] has achieved all objectives. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20260407-iran-war-is-going-to-conclude-very-shortly-says-us-vice-president/ (Middle East Monitor)]
